title: Application for a passenger transport licence code
summary: This page provides information on how to apply for a Passenger Transport Licence Code (PTLC) if you provide passenger transport services in New South Wales.
intro: If you provide passenger transport services in New South Wales such as taxis, private hire, rideshare or tour drive operations, you’ll need to apply for a passenger transport licence code (PTLC).
who_can_apply: Meet medical standards for commercial vehicle drivers.
Provide a medical report if you declare a medical condition.
Provide an eyesight report from an optometrist or ophthalmologist if you declare a vision or eye disorder.
Have held an unrestricted Australian driver licence for at least 12 months in the last 4 years.
what_you_need: Unrestricted Australian driver licence with an expiry date that is 5 years or less
Completed commercial standard medical test (if applicable)
Eyesight report by an optometrist or ophthalmologist (if applicable)

how_to_steps.text: Complete, print and sign the form.
Visit a service centre and submit your application.

more_info.text: Once you’ve applied, you'll hear back from Transport for NSW within 14 business days.
The PTLC will appear on your driver licence under 'Conditions'.
A driver licence holder with a PTLC will be subject to 0.02 blood alcohol concentration when driving a point to point passenger service or public passenger service.
For first time applications for a PTLC, you'll need to pass a commercial eyesight test.
When renewing your driver licence, you’ll need to re-apply for your PTLC, and pass a commercial eyesight test each time.
If you wish to remove the PTLC from your licence, you can make a request at a service centre. There's no cost involved.

faqs.q: What services require a Passenger Transport Licence Code (PTLC)?
faqs.a: You need a PTLC if you provide passenger transport services in New South Wales, such as taxis, private hire, rideshare, or tour drive operations.

faqs.q: What are the eligibility requirements for applying for a PTLC?
faqs.a: You must meet medical standards for commercial vehicle drivers, have held an unrestricted Australian driver licence for at least 12 months in the last 4 years, and provide specific reports if you have medical or vision conditions.

faqs.q: Where do I submit my application?
faqs.a: You must visit a service centre to submit your application.
